entities.name: Yurii Sodol
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yurii Ivanovych Sodol is a retired Ukrainian lieutenant general and was the commander of the Joint Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine from February to June 2024. Before that, he was the commander of the Ukrainian Marine Corps from 2018 to 2024.
